en.askTitle: Enter your own qualification, English score and savings and get the same NCLEX, EB-3 wait and agency-contract check
en.runTitle: Daegu to a US hospital: a Korean ward nurse weighs an EB-3 agency route against applying directly

fields.label: Nursing qualification
fields.value: Registered nurse with a 4-year BSN and 5 years of ward experience

fields.label: State you are considering
fields.value: New York or another state that accepts foreign-educated nurses

fields.label: Direct hospital offer or an agency
fields.value: Weighing a US staffing agency that sponsors an EB-3 green card against applying directly to hospitals

en.template: Help me plan RN work in the US from {city}. I am a {qualification}, my IELTS Academic result is {ielts}, I have {savings} and I am considering {state} and {route}. Rebuild the timeline and the budget with my own numbers, work out the EB-3 wait as arithmetic from the bulletin date I paste in, and check any agency contract I paste in against the warning signs, marking anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Read the exam, nursing-board, visa-bulletin and pay pages, then write and check the guide
phases.note: Exam and state board, the EB-3 wait as arithmetic, agency-contract warning signs and a KRW and USD budget
phases.judgment: It named its weak spots instead of hiding them: the EB-3 cut-off date came from a third-party copy because the official Visa Bulletin page blocked every automated route, so it is flagged unconfirmed. And the roughly 28-month wait is presented as arithmetic, not a forecast.
